description: Create a tracked finding from an insight, retaining the supplied summary and references for follow-up.

details.description: Optional bounded metadata using only the listed fields, such as summary, status and referenceIds. Not arbitrary command arguments or source content.

executionId.description: Execution record ID returned when the execution was registered; associates this call with that execution. Not a session or project ID.

findingId.description: Existing finding ID in this project, from its finding list or a finding creation result.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

projectId.description: Owned Brain Scanner project ID from the account's project list; not a local path or repository URL.

sessionId.description: ID of this project's active agent session, returned when the session was started. Not needed for read-only calls.

name: promote_insight_to_finding
title: Promote insight to finding
